== Walkthrough == Vira may be found on the balcony to the left, at +410, +85. She will give quest dialog and rewards to a level 9 Magician (perhaps lower). You say, 'Hail, Vira' : Vira says 'I am Vira, elementalist of Solusek Ro. I guard the secrets of the tools of [elemental summoning]. If you are a magician, you might be interested.' You say, 'What is elemental summoning?' : Vira says 'I hold the secrets to the construction of four tools which assist magicians with the summoning of elementals. I know about the [broom of Trilon], the [shovel of Ponz], the [torch of Alna] and the [stein of Ulissa].' You say, 'What of the torch of Alna?' : Vira says 'The torch of Alna was constructed and held by the fire mistress of the same name. Are you [interested] in the [torch]?' You say, 'I am interested in the torch.' : Vira says 'I will make a replica of the torch of Alna for you, but I will need the following items to make it: a fire emerald, a scale from a fire drake, a torch from a magician in Najena and the toes of a fire giant. Bring me these four components, and I will build for you an object of elemental power.' '''She wants the following four items:''' {{CheckboxList}} * [[Fire Emerald]] may be purchased from a jewelry merchant * [[Fire Drake Scale]] drops from various fire drakes in the [[Lavastorm Mountains]] and [[Solusek's Eye]] (Sol A) * [[A Torch]] (not just "Torch", identifies as "Torch of Fire") drops from the magicians and goblin magicians in [[Najena]] or alligators in [[Cazic_Thule_(Zone)]] or [[Lake Rathetear]]. * [[Fire Giant Toes]] drop from various fire giants around the world. {{End}} '''After turn in:''' : Vira says 'All of the pieces of the famous Torch of Alna! I never thought you would find them all! As you have displayed courage, I grant you this torch.'
* Your faction standing with [[Temple Of Sol Ro]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Shadowed Men]] got worse.
{{YouGainExperience}} You receive the {{:Torch of Alna}}. [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Temple of Solusek Ro]] [[Category:Magician Quests]] [[Category:Magician Focus Items]]
